posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
Greetings Sentinels Fans!

We can now confirm that Greater Than Games will be in London on 20 October 2013 hosting a Greater Than Games Game Day at Leisure Games in London! We (Christopher and Paul - no Adam, sadly) will be there during the store's entire operating hours from 11am to 5pm, and will be giving out promo cards, playing games, and answering (some) questions. Everyone in the UK some come say hi!
